changelog:
Initial release of gxp-compliance skill for GxP compliance assessment and supplier questionnaire analysis.

- Provides structured methods for GxP compliance checks (GMP, GLP, GCP, GDP, CSV, GAMP5, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity, etc.).
- Includes templates for supplier questionnaire analysis, risk scoring, and compliance gap reports.
- Supplies ready-to-use checklists, evaluation matrices, and reporting formats (Markdown).
- Lays out key assessment criteria, risk definitions, and supplier approval standards.
- Offers practical examples for supplier evaluation, Part 11 compliance, and GAMP5 categorization.
